top.line: VoiceDebrief meets the sovereign website: transcription for one sector, sold as a certified team in a repository.

in-short.line: A sector bundle, sold by sector AI companies, run by the customer's AI, a certified team, governance by design.

origin.line: VoiceDebrief and MeetScribe transcribe; sovereign websites taught how to sell a repository with a team inside.

company.line: A small AI company from one sector, with its people and relationships, sells to that sector.

bundle.line: Drop, transcribe, make sense, review against the rules, produce, keep; with a website, local or published.

team.line: A researcher, a writer, a rules reviewer, a designer, a document manager and a conductor, certified.

governance.line: In the customer's environment and AI account: the data stays where its rules say; it augments the worker.

sectors.line: Real estate, travel, technology, legal, medical: one open pattern, many sector companies.

price.line: £50 to £500 semi-automated, £1,500 with meetings, £5,000 with days of work.

open.line: Open source underneath; they pay for certification, delivery, support and knowledge.

limits.line: No sector bundle yet; governance helped, not replaced; prices proposed.

sources.line: The VoiceDebrief, MeetScribe and sovereign website pieces.
